en_US: You came from Olivine?
Do you remember the four islands
along the way?
I heard that a mythical sea creature is
hiding in them.
Hey, kid! Isn’t Gligar the
best Pokémon? {YESNO 0}
You agree? Awesome. You should raise
your very own Gligar.
Then use this to evolve it!
Equip that item to a Gligar and level it
up at night. It should evolve into a
fabulous Gliscor!
Hey, kid! Isn’t Sneasel the
best Pokémon? {YESNO 0}
You agree? Awesome. You should raise
your very own Sneasel.
Then use this to evolve it!
Equip that item to a Sneasel and level
it up at night. It should evolve into
an extravagant Weavile!
You don’t think so?
At first, I was overjoyed to see you.
Now, I only want you gone!
